chunks: When mischiefs come they confuse (right with wrong) and when they clear away they leave a warning. They cannot be known at the time of approach but are recognized at the time of return. They blow like the blowing of winds, striking some cities and missing others.

key_terms.يُنْكَرْنَ: they are denied or not recognized

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of fitan (trials) according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) characterizes fitan as deceptive forces that obscure truth during their ascent and reveal it in their retreat, a concept deeply rooted in Shia eschatological thought regarding the cyclical nature of trials. This metaphor of the 'whirling wind' highlights the indiscriminate yet specific impact of civil strife, warning believers to discern the essence of conflict through its aftermath rather than its initial chaos. The description serves as a practical guide for navigating political and spiritual turmoil, emphasizing patience and clarity amidst confusion.
